title: Kicked Light Jamaican Vegetable Wrap
description: A light and herbal Jamaican dish featuring hot sauce and wrapped in a ti leaf, this wrap is perfect for a springy snack or lunch. It is satvik friendly and made with ssam wrap style
instructions: Start by preparing the ti leaves by washing and drying them with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, combine the grated carrots, sliced zucchini, sliced red bell pepper, and thinly sliced onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the jamaican hot sauce and lime juice.
Pour the hot sauce mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Stir in the chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
To assemble the wraps, lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the vegetable mixture onto the center of the ti leaf.
Fold the bottom edge of the ti leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Serve the wraps immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
